items.exampleEn: In biology class, we learned about plants and animals.
items.exampleZh: 生物課上，我們學了植物和動物。

items.exampleEn: Scientists classify animals into different groups.
items.exampleZh: 科學家把動物分成不同的類別。

items.exampleEn: We mixed two liquids in our chemistry lesson.
items.exampleZh: 我們在化學課上混合了兩種液體。

items.exampleEn: My whole family came to my graduation.
items.exampleZh: 我全家人都來參加我的畢業典禮。

items.exampleEn: Her biography was made into a movie.
items.exampleZh: 她的傳記被拍成了電影。

items.exampleEn: The book uses graphic pictures to explain the steps.
items.exampleZh: 這本書用圖像來說明步驟。

items.exampleEn: The school is famous for its excellence in music.
items.exampleZh: 這所學校以音樂方面的卓越表現聞名。

items.exampleEn: Corrections help you learn from your mistakes.
items.exampleZh: 訂正能幫你從錯誤中學習。

items.sentenceEn: Our graduation ceremony is in June.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的畢業典禮在六月。

items.audioEn: The chemistry test is moved from Tuesday to Friday because the lab is being cleaned.
items.audioZh: 化學考試從星期二改到星期五，因為實驗室在清理。

items.sentenceEn: Please check your work and make any corrections.
items.sentenceZh: 請檢查你的作業並做必要的修改。

items.stemEn: Librarians ____ books by subject so they are easy to find.
items.stemZh: 圖書館員依主題把書分類，方便尋找。
她為網站設計平面圖像。

items.passageEn: At my brother's graduation, the head of the school gave a speech about excellence. My brother studied biology and chemistry, and he wants to be a doctor. His friend, who studied art, now works as a graphic designer. During the ceremony, each student received a small book: a biography of the scientist who started the school. When my brother walked onstage, my family gave him loud applause.
items.passageZh: 在我哥哥的畢業典禮上，校長發表了一篇關於卓越的演講。我哥哥讀的是生物和化學，他想當醫生。他一位讀藝術的朋友，現在是平面設計師。典禮中，每位學生都收到一本小書：創校科學家的傳記。我哥哥走到台前時，我們全家給了他熱烈的掌聲。

questions.questionZh: 作者的哥哥讀的是什麼？

options: 一本創校科學家的傳記

items.promptZh: 老師用紅筆幫我改了幾個地方。
referenceEn: The teacher made a few corrections in red pen.
My teacher made some corrections with a red pen.
rubricZh: correction 表示「訂正、修改」，例如 make corrections 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.instructionZh: 用 biography 造一個句子，說說你讀過或想讀的傳記。
referenceEn: I once read a biography of a famous football player.
I want to read a biography of my favorite singer.
rubricZh: biography 表示「傳記」，例如 a biography of… 等說法
說的是自己的經驗或想法（例如 I）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）
